name: Duleep Singh I
role: Last Maharaja of the Sikh Empire (1843–1849) and later claimant in exile
summary: Duleep Singh sought recovery of his inherited status and Punjab kingdom after years of residence in Britain. His later campaign combined Sikh restoration with appeals for Russian intervention, but he sought reconciliation and a royal pardon in 1890; little evidence establishes a wider domestic policy program.
